editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset
items.summary: The exercise dataset (exercises-dataset) shared by Hasaneyldrm offers 433 different fitness movements with names, target muscle groups, equipment and visual instructions. This comprehensive resource provides a structured data infrastructure for those developing sports technology applications.

items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
items.summary: OmniRoute is a gateway that offers free access by combining more than 231 artificial intelligence providers into a single endpoint. It reduces token usage with advanced compression techniques, while optimizing developer tools with smart backup and multi-modal interface support.

items.title: Mebus/cupp
items.summary: Common User Passwords Profiler is a Python tool for creating targeted password lists. It prepares customized dictionary files (wordlists) by analyzing specific user data.

items.title: google/agents-cli
items.summary: The command-line interface (CLI) developed by Google makes coding assistants specialized in creating, evaluating and deploying artificial intelligence agents on Google Cloud (Google Cloud). This Python-based tool standardizes agent development processes and accelerates operational workflows on cloud infrastructure.

items.title: ogulcancelik/herdr
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, herdr functions as an agent multiplexer running on the terminal. This tool allows users to manage multiple artificial intelligence agents simultaneously in the terminal environment.

items.title: CoreBunch/Instatic
items.summary: Instatic is a modern self-hosted visual content management system (CMS) based on TypeScript. It allows users to run the content management interface on their own servers with a quick installation process.

items.title: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
items.summary: Prepared by Microsoft, AI for Beginners teaches introductory topics to artificial intelligence through Jupyter Notebooks, with a 12-week curriculum. This content of 24 lessons offers a structured educational resource for those who want to learn basic concepts with applied examples.

items.title: facebook/astryx
items.summary: Developed by Meta, Astryx offers a design system that is fully customizable and compatible with artificial intelligence agents. This TypeScript-based open source library configures interface components for the use of autonomous systems.

items.title: Claude Code is steganographically marking requests
items.summary: The Claude Code tool, developed by Anthropic, adds invisible data to the requests sent and marks them with the steganography method. This technique functions as a monitoring mechanism developed to track usage data of artificial intelligence models and manage security processes.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5
items.summary: Anthropic has released an updated version of the Claude 3.5 Sonnet model, providing performance improvements in coding and reasoning capabilities. The new model expands the capacity to perform direct transactions via interfaces with computer use capability.

items.title: Department of Commerce has lifted export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
items.summary: The Ministry of Commerce lifted export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models. This regulation frees the commercial access and use of these artificial intelligence models in international markets.

items.title: Claude Science
items.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Science, a tool designed to analyze complex data sets and validate hypotheses in scientific research. This tool aims to increase the capabilities of large language models in academic literature review and data processing processes.

items.title: Nano Banana 2 Lite
items.summary: Google announced the Gemini Flash Lite model, which is optimized for low-latency visual processing processes. This model was designed to perform fast image analysis on devices with limited resources.
